description: This file contains unit tests for the TraceEntry class, verifying methods such as getFullTrace(), getIndex(), getTimestamp(), getFramesRange(), and getValue(). It sets up a mock Trace object with sample data and uses testing frameworks to assert expected behaviors.

classes.name: TraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a single trace entry with temporal and spatial information.

methods.name: getFullTrace
methods.description: Returns the complete trace object associated with this entry.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of this trace entry within the trace.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp associated with this trace entry.

methods.name: getFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the range of frames associated with this trace entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value stored in this trace entry.
